title: Dizon orders safety check, retrofitting of old CamSur bridges

blocks.text: BAAO, CAMARINES SUR — Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon has ordered the inspection and retrofitting of old bridges along the Maharlika Highway in Camarines Sur to ensure their structural stability and safety. Dizon issued the directive Thursday after inspecting the Daang Maharlika Highway and checking the progress of road projects and the condition of bridges along the major thoroughfare. Among the bridges he inspected was the San Francisco Bridge in the municipality of Baao, which forms part of the Maharlika Highway, a major transport route linking Luzon with the Visayas and Mindanao.
